note: Expected decode of each recording in this folder, fed from the start in pieces of any size (results must not depend on the piece size). All recordings: cf32_le, 12 000 samples/s, the dial (suppressed carrier of an upper sideband receiver) at 0 Hz of the samples, so an audio tone of f Hz is at +f Hz. Times are seconds of signal. 'contains' means the decoded text must contain that string; 'exact' fields must match; numeric ranges are inclusive. Unless stated, the mode's settings are its defaults, with automatic signal finding on. Garbage characters before the first lock are allowed (they are not checked), except where 'max_chars' or 'no_text' is given.

hfkbd_sitorb_12k.sent: 30 phasing places (beta in DX, alpha in RX), the text as ITA2 in CCIR 476 words (LTRS first, FIGS before the figures), 10 phasing places, three times; each character in DX and again 5 places later in RX; 100 Bd, mark (B, 1) at 1615 Hz, space (Y, 0) at 1785 Hz; 7-unit words sent least significant bit first
hfkbd_sitorb_12k.polarity: The recording has B on the lower tone. ITU-R M.625-4 Table 1 note 3 puts B on the higher emitted frequency, so the receiver reads it as inverted.
